messages.subject: GSoC 2015 Mentor Summit
messages.body_plain:
Dear Org Admins and Mentors,

Carol has recently sent a group e-mail on the Mentor Summit 2015. Do we already have the 1-2 attendees and are they already registered?
Probably we should not miss this promising opportunity to meet other mentors and be part of this inspiring event.

Thanks,
Gergely
